main_conclusion: No explored version demonstrates substantially fewer false alarms while retaining at least 16/17 correct complete trial witnesses. The historical detection baseline remains the retained reference; no new version is promoted.

retained_reference.meaning: Historical fixed-configuration witness coverage; not precision of all alarms, generalization to unseen tasks, or patch-repair/hidden-test success.

evaluation_qualification.scope: Evaluation-only qualification, not method/provider input. Canonical P6 label retained; the public issue wording alone does not uniquely determine its internal-alias expectation, and the exact generated repeated-reference program was not found executed against the reference. The aggregate is not upgraded beyond that evidence.

compact_v6_admission.interpretation: Rejecting 18 of 29 confirmed false initial alarms does not meet the joint objective because the same version rejects three canonical positive witnesses and one heldout valid test. Unknown is not counted as a correct rejection. Candidate holdout uses development-seen tasks; the majority of 1438 distinct original controlled failures remains unadjudicated, so overall false-positive rate is unknown.

analysis_inside_generation.implemented_operation: Extract a source read address, retrieve source writer actions, solve receiver/key substitutions, then construct a test edit. The v2 owner/field index is queried before the pair budget is allocated.

v2.comparison_limit: The arms change both retrieval and key unification. This is not an isolated field-index ablation; zero hits provide no evidence of pruning or detection improvement.

analysis_inside_generation.source_failure_explanation: The indexed-field read fragment exposes demands in only P5/P6. In v1, all ten demands are in groups with no source actions, so no address pair is tried; this does not isolate grouping as the sole cause. Removing grouping in v2 still yields zero owner matches. Source-action closure excludes the corresponding writers; admitted source calls elsewhere have not yet passed recipient-specific binding and rendering. Missing extracted dependencies remain unknown, not evidence of no combination gap.

authored_example.limit: Demonstrates receiver/key construction and the need to reconsider the oracle under an explicit authored contract, not benchmark detection or automatic oracle correctness.

mixed_value_state_check.result: The clearest six source instances already admit a nine-statement slice through the existing producer constructor. Matching a shared container field does not show that its observed portion changes; this census establishes no new construction capability.

analysis_inside_generation.academic_conclusion: Program analysis now directly constrains construction in an isolated prototype, but no effective new core abstraction or academic novelty has been established. Slicing, dependency matching and unification are classic techniques; Clouseau already uses effect dependencies to guide test generation.

other_preserved_source_improvements: Finite invocation-specific assertion/control context and source provenance fixes used by the compact semantic review.
Reported failure-location mapping back to original assertions; it does not establish the first causal failure or semantic validity.
Ordered same-binding call history; lexical order is not heap, alias or guest-language state reasoning.

provider_cost_this_window.limit: Incremental research review of previously generated tests, not the cost of a fresh end-to-end plugin run. HTTP400 calls without usage retain their reservations.

historical_generation_cost_separate_from.conclusion: Low-overhead deployment has not been established.

verification_scope.note: These are selected new-component checks, not a claimed whole-repository suite or a fresh benchmark rerun. Source snapshots and raw usage receipts are verified by the final audit.

uncompleted_research: A source-analysis construction rule that yields more useful witnesses under the same component/edit/semantic budget, or obtains the same witnesses at lower cost; a syntactically new output language is not required.
An equal-budget comparison that isolates the proposed rule and measures useful candidates per cost, retaining unsupported cases in the denominator.
Reliable oracle reasoning that rejects false alarms without losing the historical correct witnesses.
Unseen-task generalization and a measured patch-repair/hidden-test evaluation.

fallback.action: Keep the verified historical detection baseline and version all completed exploratory rounds without promoting the failed variants.

next_falsifiable_question: Given identical source components, edit space and semantic budget, does backward solving of cross-slice receiver, argument and order constraints from an observation phase improve valid complete witness yield or cost on preregistered unseen tasks? This is an unvalidated question, not an implemented general solver.
post_deadline_actions: Documentation corrections, read-only final receipt/hash audit and Git archival only; no additional provider or benchmark experiments.
